caption: The drawing shows two objects that resemble mechanical banks. The main object in the foreground is a three-dimensional figure standing on a rectangular base. The figure is dressed in a blue shirt with white stars, red and white vertically striped pants, a brown coat, and a tall striped hat. The figure has pale skin, white hair and beard, and its right arm is extended forward with the hand open. The left hand is holding a black umbrella. Next to the figure, on the base, there is a brown satchel labeled "U.S." The base is reddish with detailing in light brown or gold. On the base's front side, an eagle design is depicted above the words "UNCLE SAM BANK." In the background, a smaller version of the main object is seen from behind, showing the back of the figure, the umbrella, and the satchel. The background of the drawing is a plain, light tan color.
title: Toy Bank: Uncle Sam
